s.note: Haku gives Chihiro rice balls. Salted rice balls, umeboshi, nori.
s.how: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, then cook it with the water, covered, on low heat. Rest the rice for 10 minutes off the heat, then spread it out to cool a little. Wet and salt your hands, take a handful of rice, push a piece of plum into the middle and press into a triangle. Wrap a strip of nori around the base of each and sprinkle with sesame.

s.note: No-Face pays the staff in gold. Salmon and cucumber rolls, egg rolls, soy and pickled ginger.
s.how: Cook the sushi rice, then fold through the seasoning and cool to room temperature. Beat the eggs with the sugar, cook into a thin omelette and cut into strips. Lay a nori sheet on a bamboo mat, spread with rice, line up salmon and cucumber or egg, and roll up tightly. Slice each roll into 8 with a wet knife and serve with soy and ginger.

m.n: Spirit town char siu pork buns
m.note: The feast that turns her parents into pigs. Sticky char siu pork, soft steamed buns, cucumber.
m.how: Coat the pork in the char siu sauce and leave for 15 minutes. Roast on a rack at 200C for 35 minutes, then brush with honey and soy and roast 10 minutes more until sticky. Rest, then slice thinly. Steam the buns until soft and puffy. Fill each bun with hoisin, pork, cucumber and spring onion.

m.note: Kamaji bribes Lin with a roasted newt. Chicken and spring onion skewers, sweet soy glaze, rice.
m.how: Simmer the soy, apple juice, sugar and ginger until syrupy, then cool. Cook the rice. Thread the chicken and spring onion onto the skewers. Grill over high heat, turning and brushing with the glaze, until charred and cooked through. Serve on the rice with the rest of the glaze.

w.note: Lin brings Sen a red bean bun. Soft steamed buns, sweet red bean paste.
w.how: Mix the flour, yeast, baking powder and sugar, then add the milk and oil and knead to a smooth dough. Cover and leave somewhere warm until puffy. Divide into 10, flatten each, wrap around a spoonful of bean paste and pinch closed. Sit each on a square of baking paper and steam over boiling water until puffed and springy.

d.n: Zeniba's iced barley tea with honey and yuzu
d.note: Zeniba makes everyone some tea. Roasted barley tea, honey, a squeeze of yuzu.
d.how: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, then remove and stir in the honey. Cool, add the yuzu and chill. Pour over ice to serve.
